svg.title: Coding agent architecture (light)
svg.desc: Setup: GitHub issue URL, issue_fetcher and repo_cloner, env_builder builds an image with a copy of the repo, docker_manager starts a container with nothing mounted. Agent loop: Claude picks a tool through registry.py; view, edit and repo_map tools run on the host repo, which is the source of truth; search, test and shell tools run in a disposable sandbox container that receives host edits before each command. Test output is parsed, state is updated, strategy_manager adds nudges and stopping_criteria decides whether to continue or exit. Output: patch_validator produces the final diff, the run is resolved, unverified or unresolved, pr_creator opens a PR only when resolved, and trajectory_logger records every event.
svg.text: sees issue, repo map, tool results, nudges
Guards: no .git, no test files, no pytest
config changes, syntax-checked, line endings kept
No network, all capabilities dropped. Test runs
